candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ม' (tho mo) and words containing it, as well as tokenization artifacts and noise associated with it.
This vector represents the Thai script character "ต" (to tao) and its various diacritical and contextual combinations within tokenized text.
This vector is related to Thai consonantal characters and character fragments.
These tokens represent Thai character sequences, subwords, and loanword fragments centered around common Thai linguistic roots and prefixes.
This vector activates on various word roots, subwords, and foreign characters related to meteorological terms, structures, and locations.
These tokens represent common prefixes and morphologic roots used to form nouns and adjectives in English.
This vector activates on Latin-derived nominal and adjectival suffixes or word endings.
This feature vector represents random noise and multilingual subwords with no cohesive semantic concept.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens or fragments from various non-English languages and scripts.
These tokens are common conjunctions, prepositions, punctuation marks, and sub-word fragments appearing frequently across multilingual text processing.
